description: Retrieve latest available or historically dated FIRST EPSS probability and percentile for supplied CVEs. Process up to 500 unique entries from batchOffset; response byte limits can return fewer whole entries. Resume with nextBatchOffset as batchOffset, the original cves and returned score date as date. deferredCves were not queried; withheldCves were processed but omitted, and either list can be a declared preview. Missing scores remain unknown; use epss_list_reference for coverage and interpretation.

batchOffset.description: Resume in first-occurrence normalized unique input order; resubmit the original cves, returned score date and original policy/severity inputs.

cves.description: One to 5000 CVE identifiers; whitespace, comma or semicolon-delimited strings are also accepted.

items.description: Complete CVE-YYYY-NNNN identifier; whitespace, case and Unicode dashes are normalized.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD from 2021-04-14 through today; omitted or blank selects latest available data.

name: epss_get_scores

batchOffset.description: Starting offset in the original normalized unique input.

budgetLimited.description: True when whole entries or accounting lists were shortened to fit the serialized response budget.

deferredCount.description: Identifiers beyond this call workload cap, not queried.

deferredCves.description: Never-queried identifiers beyond this call workload cap; complete unless deferredCvesComplete is false. Resume using nextBatchOffset and the original submission.

deferredCvesComplete.description: True when deferredCves includes every never-queried deferred identifier.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `snapshot_unavailable`: FIRST identifies the requested dated snapshot as unavailable. `upstream_shape`: The upstream envelope, score data, batch completeness or snapshot consistency is invalid. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextBatchOffset.description: Resume with this batchOffset and the original cves, returned date and original severity/policy inputs.

processedCount.description: Unique identifiers processed, including invalid formats.

status.description: verified: matching metadata; inferred: published schedule; unavailable: unknown.

scoreDates.description: Returned anchor or candidate score dates.

returnedCount.description: Processed identifiers whose complete score, history or unscored entry is included.

scores.description: Forecasts ordered by EPSS descending then CVE.

items.description: Daily exploitation forecast and model attribution.

epss.description: 0–1 probability of observed exploitation within the next 30 days.

modelVersion.description: Verified or inferred scoring model version when available.

modelVersionSource.description: csv_header: verified metadata; published_schedule: inferred; unavailable: unknown.

unscoredCves.description: Retained processed identifiers without scores, in request order.

items.description: Identifier with an explicitly unknown forecast.

reason.description: Invalid identifier or upstream omission; neither implies zero risk.

withheldCount.description: Processed identifiers withheld by the response byte budget; queried valid entries are included in processedCount.

withheldCves.description: Already processed identifiers withheld by the byte budget, in original input order; may be a preview.

items.description: Already processed identifier withheld from this response.

withheldCvesComplete.description: True when withheldCves includes every withheld identifier.

title: Epss Get Scores
